name: Your name
authIntro: A little clarity. A lot more peace of mind.
authNote: Your money, your pace. Build a plan that fits your everyday life.
checkEmail: Check your email for the next step. If you requested a reset and an account exists, a link is on its way.
passwordSaved: Password updated. You can now sign in with your new password.
authFailed: We couldn’t sign you in. Check your email and password, then try again.
authRequestFailed: The request couldn’t be completed. Please try again shortly.
invalidLink: This email link has expired or is invalid. Request a new link.
heroTitle:
Track your expenses.
Know what you can spend today.
heroText: Record income and expenses, set aside money for upcoming payments, and plan your daily spending. In English and Amharic.
freeStart: Free to start. Record transactions yourself; no bank connection.
exampleNote: With 1,500 ETB in hand, 400 ETB for essentials, and 100 ETB reserved for savings.
builtFor: A simple routine for your money.
step1Text: Enter the money you have and choose how long it needs to last. Add bills and savings now or later.
step2Text: Add an expense when you spend and income when it arrives. Correct a record whenever you need to.
step3Text: See what is left for today and review where your money went.
closingTitle:
Start with the money
you have today.
closingText: Create a plan, record your first expense, and see what changes.
privacyShort: Private by design. Made for everyday life.
footer: Thoughtful money planning for everyone in Ethiopia.
onboardIntro: Enter your available money and an end date. You can add bills and savings whenever you are ready.
balanceHint: Include cash and mobile money you can spend. Don’t include income that hasn’t arrived.
horizon: What is this end date for?
savingsLabel: Total to set aside for savings (ETB)
savingsHint: Enter the full amount you want to keep for savings. This replaces the previous amount; it does not transfer money.
essentialLabel: Bills you still need to pay (ETB)
essentialHint: For example, rent or electricity. Add only unpaid bills. You can add more in Money plan.
onboardFooter: Everything in your plan can be adjusted later. Your opening balance stays fixed; record income or expenses to change cash.
dashboardIntro: See what you have, what is set aside, and what you can spend today.
guideNote: This estimate depends on keeping your records up to date. A new day starts at midnight in Addis Ababa.
allocationNote: Today’s budget is calculated before today’s everyday expenses. New income or changes to your plan update it. Payments for reserved bills use the money already set aside.
calculationText: Start with your current balance. Subtract unpaid bills and the amount set aside for savings. What remains is your everyday spending money.
todayCalculation: Subtract today’s everyday expenses from today’s budget to get what is left today. This never exceeds the money left after bills and savings, and stops at zero. If your plan has ended, the calculation uses one day until you choose a new end date.
attention: A small plan adjustment may help
runway: How long your spending money may last
runwayNote: An estimate using your recorded everyday expenses from the last 7 days, after bills and savings are set aside. It is not your plan end date.
notEnoughData: Record an everyday expense to see an estimate
expectedOnly: Expected income is not included in your balance. Record it when it arrives.
noTransactionsText: Your income and expenses will appear here as you record them.
noCommitmentsText: Add rent, electricity, or another upcoming bill in Money plan to set money aside for it.
noResultsText: Try a different search or clear your filters.
transactionIntro: Review the money you received and spent. Search, filter, or correct a record below.
deleteText: This changes your balance or reserved money. Deleting a commitment payment also reopens that commitment.
saved: Saved. Your plan is up to date.
deleted: Record deleted. Your plan has been updated.
settlementLocked: Paid commitments are linked to their payment. Delete the payment first to reopen and edit the commitment.
transactionDateRange: Choose a date from your wallet’s opening date through today.
recordedFrom: Record new cash movements from {date}. Your starting balance already includes earlier activity.
planIntro: Choose how long your money needs to last, set savings aside, and manage unpaid bills.
newPeriod: Start a new month or period
newPeriodText: Your current balance, past transactions, and unpaid bills will carry forward. The end date and total savings amount shown below will replace your current plan. This does not add income or repeat paid bills.
payText: Only continue if you have actually paid it. We’ll record the expense and release its reserve together, so it isn’t counted twice.
planExplanation: Add payments you still need to make. Choose Record payment only after you have paid: this records the expense and releases the reserved amount together.
periodHistoryText: Starting a new period keeps your transaction history. Use date filters in Transactions or Insights to review a previous month.
insightsIntro: See your income, expenses, and spending by category for the dates you choose.
snapshotNote: Allocations are recorded on days you change your plan or ledger. Missing days are left blank. Editing earlier activity does not rewrite past allocations.
insightsEmpty: A clearer picture is on its way.
insightsEmptyText: Record a few transactions to see your spending patterns here.
topCategory: Your largest expense category is {category}: {amount} in this range.
periodNet: Your recorded income minus expenses for this range is {amount}.
rangeInvalid: The start date must be on or before the end date.
settingsIntro: Update your profile, language, appearance, and account settings.
privacyText: Your financial records are private to your account and stored in Supabase. LastBirr does not connect to your bank or move money. Only record information you’re comfortable saving.
planningPreferences: Manage planning dates and savings in Money plan.
signoutFailed: Couldn’t sign out. Please try again.
invalidMoney: Enter an amount with no more than two decimal places (maximum 10 billion ETB).
positiveMoney: Enter an amount greater than zero.
futureTransaction: Only record money that has already moved. Choose today or an earlier date.
futurePlan: Choose today or a future date.
invalidCategory: Choose a category for this transaction type.
invalidForm: Check the form details and try again.
saveFailed: We couldn’t save this change. Check your connection and try again.
sessionExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
databaseUnavailable: Your data couldn’t be loaded. Check your connection and make sure the LastBirr database migration has been applied.

warnings.commitmentShortage: Your balance won’t cover all unpaid essentials. Review the amounts and prioritize the payments you need most.
warnings.savingsRisk: Your balance cannot cover both unpaid bills and the savings amount. Review them in Money plan.
warnings.overspent: You have spent more than today’s budget. Review today’s entries and the money left for the rest of your plan.
warnings.missingDate: Add a planning end date. Until then, the guide uses one day.
warnings.overdue: Your expected income or planning date has passed. Update the date, and only record income when it arrives.
warnings.endsToday: Your plan ends today. Open Money plan to choose your next end date.
warnings.approaching: Your planning date is close. Check whether your next income is still on schedule.
warnings.pace: Your recent spending pace is above your daily guide. Review upcoming spending or adjust the plan.

phoneHint: Use an Ethiopian mobile number: 09…, 07…, or +251… (spaces and hyphens are fine).
invalidPhone: Enter a valid Ethiopian mobile number, such as 0912345678 or +251712345678.
invalidName: Use letters, spaces, apostrophes, periods or hyphens for your name.
invalidPassword: Use a password that is not only spaces and contains no control characters.
authRateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
emailTaken: This email already has an account. Sign in or reset your password.
weakPassword: Choose a stronger password with at least 8 characters.
signupContactFailed: We couldn’t create your account. A contact may already be in use. Try signing in, or check your details and try again.
signupConfiguration: Signup could not sign you in. Please contact support before trying again.
simpleSignup: Your everyday money plan starts here. No email confirmation step.
signupAssurance: Your financial records stay private to your account.
phoneOwnershipNote: This is a contact number, not a verified number or a way to sign in. Use your email for password recovery.
contactSetupRequired: Contact updates are temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
phoneTaken: This phone number is already used by another account.
invalidText: Use plain text without control characters or angle brackets.
commitmentNameRequired: Give your essential payment a name of at least 2 characters.
exampleSetup: A 10-day plan: 1,500 ETB to start, 400 for unpaid bills, and 100 reserved for savings.
exampleBefore: Try recording lunch. This example does not save any data.
exampleAfter: Lunch recorded: your balance is 1,465 ETB, with 65 ETB left today. Your bills and savings stay reserved.
openingQuestion: How much money do you have? (ETB)
endQuestionHint: Choose your next income date or another date you want to plan until.
optionalReserves: Set aside money for bills or savings
optionalReservesHint: Optional. You can add these later in Money plan.
balanceExplained: Based on the income and expenses you have recorded. This includes money set aside below.
dailyGuideExplained: The average divides that remaining money by the days until your end date. Today’s budget is calculated before today’s everyday expenses, so the two amounts can differ. New income or plan changes update both.
firstExpenseTitle: Your plan is ready. Record your first expense.
firstExpenseText: Start with something you paid for today, such as food or transport. Your balance and daily budget will update.
expenseRecorded: Expense recorded. Your balance has been updated.
incomeRecorded: Income recorded. Your balance has been updated.
manualRecords: Record money when you receive or spend it. LastBirr does not connect to your bank.
accountFooter: Amounts in ETB · Dates use Addis Ababa time
dailyBudgetHint: For everyday spending, after setting aside money for unpaid bills and savings.
recentActivityHint: Your latest records. Open Transactions to search, edit, or delete an entry.
upcomingBillsHint: Up to three unpaid bills, ordered by due date. Their amounts are already set aside in your plan.
newPeriodHint: Use Update plan to adjust this period. To begin the next one, enter its end date and total savings above, then choose Start a new month or period.
newMonthHelp: Received new money or starting a new month?
incomeHelpText: Choose Add income and enter only the new amount. For example, 300 ETB left plus 5,000 ETB received gives a 5,300 ETB balance.
periodHelpText: In Money plan, enter the new end date and total savings amount. Choose Start a new month or period and confirm. Your balance and history carry forward.
billsHelpText: Unpaid bills carry forward. Add new bills for this month yourself, including recurring payments such as rent. Paid bills are not repeated automatically.
